messages:
adele: FYI incoming pen-test report attached to the ticket. High severity: KMS key role scoping allows a service principal to list/decrypt across customer namespaces. Also noted gaps in audit log retention for key usage. Need triage and a retest window.

jordan: acked. can you paste the exact finding text or link the report?

adele: pasted snippet from report: 
```
Finding: KMS-001 - Overbroad key binding
Evidence: service-account 'batch-worker' has iam:Decrypt + kms:ListKeys for customer-key-*
Risk: potential cross-customer data exposure
Recommendation: restrict key binding to explicit resource ARNs and enable key usage logging to central audit stream
```
Link: https://files.internal/reports/pen-test-2026/scan-blob.pdf (report PDF)

samir: we should treat this as a remediation + retest. proposed immediate actions:
- rotate affected keys OR disable cross-tenant binds (short-term)
- create scoped IAM condition limiting kms:Decrypt to the exact ARN
- enable/verify CloudAuditLogs export for CMEK usage for 90 days

elaine: +1. also need a reproducible test case for the assessor to verify retest. samir can you make a small script that demonstrates list/decrypt using the service account? put it in the evidence folder.

samir: yep. I'll push a minimal repro to the secure repo (internal link) and include sanitized logs. ETA 2h.

adele: ownership: samir = remediation lead, jordan = audit/logs lead, elaine = evidence & retest liaison. I'll file the tracker ticket.

sec-bot: created ticket SEC-472: "KMS key scoping - pen test remediation" assigned to samir; due 72h.

jordan: for audit retention: current CMEK usage logs are 30d in GA, we need to export to long-term bucket with 365d retention. I'll prepare the export policy and presigned evidence export.

elaine: retest window options: Friday 09:00-12:00 UTC or Monday 17:00-20:00 UTC. Which works for ops and the assessor? @adele please confirm with vendor.

adele: pinged vendor, they prefer Friday. locking Friday 09:00-10:30 UTC as primary, 10:30-12:00 as follow-up if needed.

samir: remediation plan (short):
1) replace IAM binding on keys matching customer-key-* with explicit resource ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/KEYID (scripted)
2) deny kms:ListKeys in that role
3) rotate ephemeral key material where feasible
4) validate with unit test + integration repro from assessor script

adele: please add the exact commands you plan to run to the ticket so we can review before execution. Example to restrict binding: 
```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name batch-worker --policy-document file://policy.json
```
policy.json should include condition: "kms:Resource" or resource ARNs.

samir: will add commands + planned maintenance window to SEC-472. note: changes touch production encryption keys; we'll request a 15-min maintenance notice and an ops-approved rollback plan.

jordan: also ensure KMS key rotation schedule isn't interrupted. I'll stub a runbook to check application failures and missing decrypt errors.

elaine: for the retest, the vendor needs: (a) sanitized repro, (b) a timestamped log export showing failed ListKeys attempts after remediation, (c) the policy diff. I'll draft a template for the evidence package.

adele: good. set an evidence deadline EOD Thursday so we can hand off to vendor Friday morning.

sec-bot: reminder scheduled: SEC-472 evidence-check Thursday 18:00 UTC.

samir: pushed repro and policy diff to secure repo: repo.internal/sec/SEC-472/repro + logs (sanitized). added commands to ticket.

jordan: export job started to long-term bucket with 365d retention; retention policy ID: R-SEC-2026-08.

elaine: vendor confirmed Friday slot and asked for pre-check run 30m before start. I'll coordinate call bridge.

adele: final checklist before remediation execution: 
- [ ] Backup key metadata and snapshot access policies
- [ ] Announce 15-min maintenance to oncall and customers if needed
- [ ] Ensure rollback policy file committed
- [ ] Evidence folder populated (repro + logs + policy diff)

jordan: added runbook snippet in SEC-472 describing what to watch for: kms:DecryptErrors, app 504 spikes, and guardrail to rollback binding.

samir: starting remediation in 30m on the non-prod replica to validate. will update thread with results.

adele: thanks team. keep updates short here. we'll close SEC-472 after vendor retest pass and an audit log verification. :thumbsup:
